stages.title: Fluency & technique
stages.summary: Scales and arpeggios hands together, inversions, Hanon, compound time, and a reading capstone.

units.title: Scales hands together: C, G, D, A

lessons.title: Scales hands together: C, G, D, A

finder.skill: playing scales hands together, two octaves, in the sharp keys
finder.levelWords: moderate, Grade 2 to 3, scales hands together, two octaves
constraints: C, G, D or A major
finder.formats: MusicXML or .mxl preferred; a PDF works but cannot be scored.

lessons.paperHint: Or the scale section of your book, or a separate scale manual if you have one: C, G, D and A hands together, two octaves, with the printed fingering.

lessons.title: Flat keys and minor scales

finder.skill: playing in flat keys and in both forms of the minor scale
finder.levelWords: moderate, Grade 2 to 3, flat keys, harmonic and melodic minor
constraints: F, B flat or E flat major
finder.formats: MusicXML or .mxl preferred; a PDF works but cannot be scored.

lessons.paperHint: Or your book's flat-key and minor scale pages — F, B flat and E flat major, and both forms of the minor.

lessons.title: Arpeggios and chord inversions

finder.skill: playing arpeggios and recognising a chord that is not in root position
finder.levelWords: moderate, Grade 2 to 3, arpeggios, chord inversions, slash chords
constraints: chords in first and second inversion
finder.formats: MusicXML or .mxl preferred; a PDF works but cannot be scored.

lessons.paperHint: Or the arpeggio pages in your book or scale manual, plus any piece that uses inversions or slash chords.

lessons.title: Hanon patterns and finger independence

finder.skill: playing an even five-finger pattern with each finger equally strong
finder.levelWords: moderate, Grade 2 to 3, Hanon, finger exercises, evenness
constraints: sequence moving up and down the keyboard
finder.formats: MusicXML or .mxl preferred; a PDF works but cannot be scored.

lessons.paperHint: Or Hanon itself if you have it — the first five exercises. Czerny op. 599 or op. 139 do the same job if that is what is on your shelf.

lessons.title: Compound time, triplets and syncopation

finder.skill: counting compound time, triplets and notes that land off the beat
finder.levelWords: moderate, Grade 2 to 3, 6/8 time, triplets, syncopation
finder.formats: MusicXML or .mxl preferred; a PDF works but cannot be scored.

lessons.paperHint: Or any piece in your book in 6/8, or one that uses triplets against a steady beat. Method books usually introduce compound time with a lilting tune.

lessons.title: Sight-reading and phrasing capstone

finder.skill: reading a new piece straight through while shaping the phrases
finder.levelWords: moderate, Grade 2 to 3, sight-reading practice, phrasing
avoid: famous tunes you already know by ear
finder.formats: MusicXML or .mxl preferred; a PDF works but cannot be scored.

lessons.paperHint: Or the sight-reading pieces at the back of your book, played once through without stopping. Choose ones you have never opened.

lessons.title: Learning it from memory

mastery.custom: two clean passes, then blind at >=0.9

lessons.paperHint: Or memorise something out of your own book — a piece you already play well and have stopped needing to read. The page is what you are trying to do without, so it hardly matters which page it was.

finder.skill: playing a piece you already know from memory, without the score
finder.levelWords: moderate, Grade 2 to 3, short pieces worth memorising
constraints: a short piece of 16 to 40 bars
a piece you would enjoy playing to somebody

examples.title: Minuet in G major, BWV Anh. 114

finder.formats: MusicXML or .mxl preferred; a PDF works but cannot be scored.

lessons.title: Grade 1 pieces and articulation

finder.skill: playing a Grade 1 classical piece with staccato, legato and ornaments in the right places
finder.levelWords: elementary to moderate, Grade 1 to 2, classical repertoire
constraints: classical repertoire rather than an arrangement
finder.formats: MusicXML or .mxl preferred; a PDF works but cannot be scored.

lessons.paperHint: Or a Grade 1 piece from a graded album on your shelf, with the articulation as printed rather than as you would like it.

lessons.title: A singing melody, and the shelf to aim at

finder.skill: voicing a melody above a quiet accompaniment and pedalling it cleanly
finder.levelWords: moderate, calm piano, ambient, melody with accompaniment
constraints: singing melody above a broken-chord accompaniment
finder.formats: MusicXML or .mxl preferred; a PDF works but cannot be scored.

lessons.paperHint: Or the easiest thing in any album of romantic favourites on your shelf — the ones sold as "classics to play" almost all come down to a melody over a broken-chord left hand. Play the melody alone until it sings, then add the accompaniment under it at half the volume.
